claim_ceiling: This is the exact first derivative at lambda=0 of one asymptotically flat, horizon-regular five-dimensional O(a^2) EGB branch. All four order-lambda original Euler-Lagrange rows vanish. It does not prove an analytic finite-lambda branch, a finite-lambda interval existence theorem, the derivative of the full two-by-two boundary-map Jacobian, full nonlinear uniqueness, or PDE hyperbolicity.
